items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And I was playing with Erskine Tate at the Savoy Ballroom

ctx.x: Because they had a lot of...a cluster of theatres around there.

Yeah. Well, they had the Grand Theatre across the street. The Grand was over on the west side, and Dave Peyton played over there -- he had the band. Erskine Tate had the band at the Vendome, which was on the east side of the street.
